newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Impact Systems Inc Q1 results.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Impact Systems Inc Q1 results.

text.p: Kenneth P. Ostrow, president and CEO, stated: "As indicated in last quarter's release, we have been adding additional resources to the organization. Therefore, spending is up on a year to year basis as opposed to a slight decrease one might expect on lower revenues. This has negatively affected profits somewhat on a comparison basis.

"Based on the opportunities that we see in the marketplace, we are continuing to recruit and hire additional resources in our sales and technical areas, which will continue to have a slight effect on short term earnings. "If we can continue to hire additional key resources and our other machine start-ups scheduled for this summer are as successful as the Consolidated start-up, we will be in an excellent position for renewed growth when the market turns up, which is anticipated to be by the end of this calendar year."
